items.title: Why Elon Musk will keep funding Grok, no matter the cost
items.summary: In the Loop Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen sets the table for why he believes Elon Musk is willing to keep pouring money into his AI project, Grok, no matter the cost. Ahamadeen explains why he believes personal AI assistants will become the “most important and valuable layer” for how people interact with the broader digital world.

items.title: Global X Launches Magnificent Six ETF
items.summary: NEW YORK, November 04, 2026--Global X launches the Global X Magnificent Six ETF, which seeks to provide exposure to Alphabet; Amazon; Apple; Meta; Microsoft; and NVIDIA.

items.title: HP Names Emma Walmsley as New CEO, Ending Monthlong Search
items.summary: HP Inc. named former GSK Plc chief executive officer Emma Walmsley as its new CEO, permanently filling the role after HP’s Enrique Lores departed earlier this year.
